digest.component_or_area: backend-neutral core reconciler paths (outbound comments, inbound translation)
propositions: Backend-neutral core modules (outbound_comments.py, inbound_translate.py, outbound_comments.py:134) load Jira-specific adapter modules by literal lazy-load keys unconditionally for any configured backend, creating vendor reach-through that violates backend neutrality

Outbound comment formatting and truncation must route through FieldSanitizer.fit_comment (pure fit-to-limit, no warning) and FieldSanitizer.sanitize_comment (send-side defense), not through lazy-loaded adapters.jira.adf and adapters.jira.comment_limits modules

Inbound rich-text normalization must route through InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text (ADF decode or identity), not through lazy-loaded adapters.jira.adf module, preserving the bug-1bb2-5da5 defense that raw ADF dicts never reach EDIT events

_normalize_adf_body must remain a public re-exported function in applier.py and inbound_translate.py for apply_inbound_records.py call sites but route through the port instead of lazy-loading vendor modules

Literal strings 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira' must be removed from outbound_comments.py, inbound_translate.py, and applier.py re-exports, except for a single recorded exemption in inbound_fields.py (the Jira InboundMapper implementation)

Backend-neutral outbound comment-diff decode at outbound_comments.py:134 must call InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text to decode ADF-dict remote bodies to text, avoiding orphaning of the deleted _ADF_KEY lazy-load
